newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to create Latam operator - report.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to create Latam operator - report.

text.p: Spanish telecoms group Telefonica plans to create a new operator in Latin America to offer data transmission and value-added services to channel international traffic to its area operators, a report said on Monday.
Telefonica de Espana was not available for immediate comment.
The new operator would also allow the entry of a U.S. partner to ensure and ease the interconnection with the United States, the report in financial newspaper Gaceta de los Negocios said.

Telefonica's international arm, TISA, announced more than a year ago that it was planning to set up a pan-American network of global services sustained initially by operators Tasa of Argentina, CTC of Chile and Telefonica de Peru.
The project would be extended in a second phase to the entire area, the report on Monday said.
Its clients will be telecommunications operators, for whom Telefonica's new pan-American operator will function as a carrier, and end users, both corporate and private.
